sources: OpusClip retention study (118,584 viral videos analyzed)
PJ Ace 7-figure agency playbook (The Creator Report 2026)
Virvid AI Video Ads Complete Guide 2026 (12 templates + ROI playbook)
_meta.principle: Pick a pattern BEFORE generating any visuals. The pattern determines beat structure, durations, and what each beat needs. Don't 'demo a product' — pick a story shape that ends with the viewer wanting to act.

universal_rules.hook_window: 0-3 seconds. Visual payoff in frame 1. Don't build to the hook, START with it.
universal_rules.audio: Music bed mandatory. Trending sounds correlate with purchase intent on TikTok. Ad music + magsafe-ting > silence + magsafe-ting (silence reads as broken).
universal_rules.captions: 80% sound-off viewers. Captions burned in, NOT relying on platform auto-CC.
universal_rules.ending: Brand at MAXIMUM prominence in last 1-2s. Walk-aways and fade-outs are anti-patterns.
universal_rules.variant_count: 20-40 hook variants per ad at scale. Hobbyists test 2-4 — don't be that.

hook_problem_solution_cta.name: Hook → Problem → Solution → CTA
hook_problem_solution_cta.use: Default for any product ad. Battle-tested across 118k+ viral videos.
hook_problem_solution_cta.fragment: Ad pattern: Hook → Problem → Solution → CTA. Beat structure: hook(2s) → problem(3s) → solution(6s) → result(3s) → cta(2s). Total length: 16s. Best for: product launches, feature reveals, Kickstarter, DTC ecom.

beats.name: hook
beats.what: Pattern interrupt visual + text overlay. Frame 1 STOPS the scroll.
beats.needs: high-contrast image, text in safe zone, visual surprise

beats.name: problem
beats.what: Show the pain state. User struggling, broken thing, low battery, etc.

beats.name: solution
beats.what: Product enters and solves. The hero moment — snap, light up, transform.
beats.needs: product clearly readable, hero camera move, anchored FLF

beats.name: result
beats.what: Show the new state — calm, charged, free, unforgeed.
beats.needs: user with product, smiling/relaxed, life moving forward

beats.name: cta
beats.what: Brand lockup card + URL/handle/offer.
beats.needs: brand mark at max prominence, URL in safe zone, deadline if applicable

before_after_bridge.name: Before-After-Bridge (BAB)
before_after_bridge.use: Product visibly transforms a state. Strong for tools, software, fitness, beauty, EDC.
before_after_bridge.fragment: Ad pattern: Before-After-Bridge (BAB). Beat structure: before(4s) → trigger(2s) → bridge(4s) → after(4s) → cta(1s). Total length: 15s. Best for: transformation products, tools, DIY, wellness.

beats.name: before
beats.what: Status quo / pain state. Slightly muted color grade.

beats.name: trigger
beats.what: Decision moment. Hand reaches for product, screen tap, etc.

beats.name: bridge
beats.what: Product in action — the transformation happening.
beats.needs: anchored FLF for the product moment

beats.name: after
beats.what: New state, brighter color grade. User happier, problem gone.

beats.name: cta
beats.what: Brand lockup + URL.

demo_reveal.name: Pure product demo
demo_reveal.use: Product itself IS the hook (visually striking, novel form factor, magnetic snap, etc.)
demo_reveal.fragment: Ad pattern: Pure product demo. Beat structure: hero_open(2s) → interaction(5s) → reveal(3s) → lockup(2s). Total length: 12s. Best for: physical product launches, Kickstarter teasers, EDC reveals.

beats.name: hero_open
beats.what: Product hero shot, low angle or extreme close-up. Pattern-interrupt visual.

beats.name: interaction
beats.what: User interacts with product — pickup, snap, attach, click, twist.

beats.name: reveal
beats.what: The wow moment — what the product DOES. LEDs, motion, transformation.
beats.needs: locked-camera macro, animate the reveal feature only

beats.name: lockup
beats.what: Brand + product name + tagline + URL.
beats.needs: static end card, brand mark + CTA

ugc_reaction.name: UGC reaction (creator review)
ugc_reaction.use: You want it to FEEL native to the feed, not like an ad. 4× higher conversion per 2026 neuroscience studies.
ugc_reaction.fragment: Ad pattern: UGC reaction (creator review). Beat structure: hot_open(3s) → reveal_use(6s) → reaction(5s) → results_proof(5s) → soft_cta(3s). Total length: 22s. Best for: DTC ecom, DTC apps, everyday-use products.

beats.name: hot_open
beats.what: Creator face on camera, holding product, blurted hook line. 'Wait, this actually...'

beats.name: reveal_use
beats.what: Show the product being used — POV or over-shoulder.

beats.name: reaction
beats.what: Cut back to creator face — genuine reaction shot.

beats.name: results_proof
beats.what: Show the outcome / result on screen or in-environment.

beats.name: soft_cta
beats.what: Creator says 'link in bio' or shows URL casually. NOT a hard sell.
beats.needs: brand handle + URL in safe zone

comedy_juxtaposition.name: Comedy + IP juxtaposition (PJ Ace pattern)
comedy_juxtaposition.use: You want viral reach. Comedy hook + familiar IP + absurd twist. $500 AI ad outperformed $500K commercial using this.
comedy_juxtaposition.fragment: Ad pattern: Comedy + IP juxtaposition (PJ Ace pattern). Beat structure: ip_setup(3s) → absurd_twist(4s) → punchline(3s) → product_payoff(5s) → lockup(3s). Total length: 18s. Best for: brand awareness, viral campaigns, founder-led brands.

beats.name: ip_setup
beats.what: Recognizable historical / cultural setting (Pompeii, Marie Antoinette, Greek mythology, etc.). Audience recognizes the trope.
beats.needs: wide establishing shot, recognizable IP visual

beats.name: absurd_twist
beats.what: Modern / brand element appears in the historical setting. Viewers laugh at the incongruity.
beats.needs: product or modern element clearly out of place

beats.name: punchline
beats.what: Native social punchline (slang, meta, ironic).

beats.name: product_payoff
beats.what: Product gets its hero moment in the absurd setting.

beats.name: lockup
beats.what: Brand reveal — 'X. From [year] to today.' Tagline.

problem_agitate_solution.name: Problem → Agitate → Solution (PAS)
problem_agitate_solution.use: High-pain-point products. Software, productivity, anti-X categories.
problem_agitate_solution.fragment: Ad pattern: Problem → Agitate → Solution (PAS). Beat structure: problem_state(4s) → agitation(5s) → intro_solution(2s) → solution_demo(6s) → cta(3s). Total length: 20s. Best for: SaaS, B2B, anti-spam/anti-fraud, health.

beats.name: problem_state
beats.what: Show the problem clearly. Frustration on a face / broken state visible.

beats.name: agitation
beats.what: Make it WORSE. Show consequences, what happens if not solved.
beats.needs: tension build, dutch angle / handheld for unease

beats.name: intro_solution
beats.what: Product enters. Pattern interrupt.

beats.name: solution_demo
beats.what: Product solves it. Calm color grade returns.

beats.name: cta
beats.what: Brand + URL + offer.

testimonial_montage.name: Testimonial montage
testimonial_montage.use: You have multiple users / use cases. Builds social proof at speed.
testimonial_montage.fragment: Ad pattern: Testimonial montage. Beat structure: hook_quote(3s) → testimonial_1(5s) → testimonial_2(5s) → testimonial_3(5s) → product_lockup(4s) → cta(3s). Total length: 25s. Best for: mature products, service businesses, post-launch growth.

beats.name: hook_quote
beats.what: Strong opening quote — text overlay over a face. 'I never thought I'd...'
beats.needs: talking head, text in safe zone

beats.name: testimonial_1
beats.what: First user, specific use case + benefit.

beats.name: testimonial_2
beats.what: Second user, different use case.

beats.name: testimonial_3
beats.what: Third user, different angle.

beats.name: product_lockup
beats.what: Product hero shot + brand + URL.

beats.name: cta
beats.what: Specific CTA — try, buy, book.

comparison.name: Versus comparison (X vs Y)
comparison.use: Differentiation against a known competitor or status quo.
comparison.fragment: Ad pattern: Versus comparison (X vs Y). Beat structure: old_way(5s) → vs_card(1s) → new_way(6s) → side_by_side(5s) → winner(2s) → cta(1s). Total length: 20s. Best for: challenger brands, feature parity claims, alternatives content.

beats.name: old_way
beats.what: Show the old/competitor way clearly. Slightly drab.

beats.name: vs_card
beats.what: Quick 'vs' transition card.

beats.name: new_way
beats.what: Show your product way. Vibrant, fast, clean.

beats.name: side_by_side
beats.what: Split screen or rapid cut of both side-by-side.
beats.needs: split diopter or hard cut sequence

beats.name: winner
beats.what: Your product wins. Visual checkmark or wordmark.

beats.name: cta
beats.what: URL + offer.

urgency_drop.name: Urgency / drop announcement
urgency_drop.use: Limited-time offer, Kickstarter end date, product drop, restock.
urgency_drop.fragment: Ad pattern: Urgency / drop announcement. Beat structure: countdown_hook(2s) → product_hero(4s) → social_proof(3s) → urgency_cta(3s). Total length: 12s. Best for: Kickstarter final 48h, BFCM, product drops, launch day.

beats.name: countdown_hook
beats.what: Big text overlay: '48 HOURS LEFT' or 'DROPS FRIDAY'.

beats.name: product_hero
beats.what: Product hero shot, premium aesthetic.

beats.name: social_proof
beats.what: 'X backers' / 'Y% funded' / 'sold out 3x' — quick proof.

beats.name: urgency_cta
beats.what: Hard CTA with deadline. 'Back now — link in bio.'
beats.needs: URL + deadline + brand at max prominence

educational_micro.name: Educational micro (teach-then-pitch)
educational_micro.use: Complex product needs framing first. Build trust via teaching, pitch at the end.
educational_micro.fragment: Ad pattern: Educational micro (teach-then-pitch). Beat structure: curiosity_hook(3s) → teach_1(7s) → teach_2(7s) → product_link(6s) → result(4s) → cta(3s). Total length: 30s. Best for: B2B SaaS, fintech, specialized hardware, professional tools.

beats.name: curiosity_hook
beats.what: Question or surprising stat. 'Most people don't know...'

beats.name: teach_1
beats.what: Explain concept clearly with visuals.

beats.name: teach_2
beats.what: Build on the teach with the deeper insight.

beats.name: product_link
beats.what: 'Here's how we solve it' — product enters as the answer.

beats.name: result
beats.what: Show the outcome of using the product.

beats.name: cta
beats.what: Brand + URL + soft CTA (trial, demo, etc.).

triangle_of_yaps.name: Triangle of Yaps (T-MAES-A talking-head skeleton)
triangle_of_yaps.use: Talking-to-camera reels, founder voice, and faceless voiceover scripts. Complete script skeleton: Topic → MAES → Application. Default structure for talking-head scripts unless overridden.
triangle_of_yaps.fragment: Ad pattern: Triangle of Yaps (T-MAES-A). Beat structure: topic_declaration(3s) → maes_concrete(12s) → application_close(5s). Total length: 20s. Rules: open with the topic itself — never a greeting or 'hey guys'; deploy exactly ONE of metaphor/analogy/example/story to make the idea concrete; close with a practical next step, not a follow/like CTA.
best_for: educational or positioning reels for any brand

beats.name: topic_declaration
beats.what: Direct declarative statement of the idea. First word is the topic — no greeting, no preamble.
beats.needs: talking head direct to lens, real face or persona

beats.name: maes_concrete
beats.what: Deploy exactly ONE of: Metaphor, Analogy, Example, or Story to make the idea concrete. Pick one, not all four.
beats.needs: talking head, optional B-roll intercut supporting the chosen MAES device

beats.name: application_close
beats.what: Practical instruction the viewer can act on, flowing from the topic. NOT a follow/like CTA.
beats.needs: talking head close, brand lockup in final 1-2s per universal_rules.ending

triangle_of_yaps.source: DYw0DtoADOE / iamjadenly (June 2026 IG absorb). Playbook overlap: components exist as craft in /content §3.2, §4, §5 — this entry is the machine-readable script template.

open_loop_mid_arrival.name: Open loop, mid-arrival (3/4 reveal pacing)
open_loop_mid_arrival.use: Retention-led hook for any feed reel. Hook phrased as if the viewer caught you mid-payoff; the reveal is withheld to the ~3/4 mark. Pairs with /content playbook §3.4 pattern 13.
open_loop_mid_arrival.fragment: Ad pattern: Open loop mid-arrival. Beat structure: mid_arrival_hook(3s) → context_deepening(9s) → near_reveal_tension(6s) → payoff_reveal(4s) → rapid_close(2s). Total length: 24s. Rules: the hook implies something is already in motion ('I almost messed this up', 'this is why X') — not a tease about something future; the payoff lands at 75% of runtime, never earlier.
best_for: any reel where retention beats immediate payoff

beats.name: mid_arrival_hook
beats.what: Opener written as if the viewer arrived mid-story. Something is already happening; 'this' implies a specific thing in motion.
beats.needs: action already underway in frame 1 — no establishing setup

beats.name: context_deepening
beats.what: Context-building that deepens the open loop. Stakes rise; the reveal is NOT approached yet.
beats.needs: B-roll or narration that raises the question, never answers it

beats.name: near_reveal_tension
beats.what: Approach the reveal, then hold. Tension escalation beats — almost-shows, interrupted explanations.
beats.needs: framing that teases the payoff object/result without disclosing it

beats.name: payoff_reveal
beats.what: The actual answer/result/reveal, landing at the 3/4 mark of total runtime.
beats.needs: anchored FLF for the reveal moment if product-centric

beats.name: rapid_close
beats.what: Immediate close after payoff. Brand at maximum prominence per universal_rules.ending.

open_loop_mid_arrival.source: DU5_W1EDApb / shotbysammy (June 2026 IG absorb). Playbook overlap: folded into /content §3.4 pattern 13 + §4.5 '~3/4 mark' — this entry is the machine-readable beat structure.

founder_story.name: Founder story (POV)
founder_story.use: Solo-founder brand, Kickstarter, indie products. Audience cares WHO made it.
founder_story.fragment: Ad pattern: Founder story (POV). Beat structure: founder_face_hook(3s) → why_built_it(6s) → what_it_does(6s) → first_user_proof(5s) → founder_cta(3s) → lockup(2s). Total length: 25s. Best for: indie hardware, Kickstarter, solo SaaS.

beats.name: founder_face_hook
beats.what: Founder talking direct to camera. Specific opening line — not generic.

beats.name: why_built_it
beats.what: Founder explains the personal pain that led to building this.

beats.name: what_it_does
beats.what: Product reveal / demo while founder narrates.
beats.needs: anchored FLF for product moment, founder VO continuing

beats.name: first_user_proof
beats.what: Brief proof — 'first 100 backers said...' or showing a real user.

beats.name: founder_cta
beats.what: Founder direct ask. 'Back us — link in bio. We made this for you.'

beats.name: lockup
beats.what: Brand mark + URL.

asmr_macro.name: ASMR macro / texture appreciation
asmr_macro.use: Premium tactile products. Watches, EDC, leather goods, knives. Sensory-driven categories.
asmr_macro.fragment: Ad pattern: ASMR macro / texture appreciation. Beat structure: texture_open(3s) → build_reveal(5s) → interaction(6s) → hero_static(4s) → lockup(2s). Total length: 20s. Best for: EDC, premium accessories, luxury goods.

beats.name: texture_open
beats.what: Macro extreme close-up of product texture. Almost abstract.

beats.name: build_reveal
beats.what: Slowly pull back to reveal what the texture belongs to.

beats.name: interaction
beats.what: Hand interacts with product — opens, snaps, deploys, twists.

beats.name: hero_static
beats.what: Product hero shot, locked camera, premium light.

beats.name: lockup
beats.what: Brand wordmark + URL.
